title: [MAIN]-Bug 644801-IRS Reporting Period - Copy Setup process will copy the 1099 Adjustments as part of the process of copying from one IRS Reporting Period to a new Period setup.
summary: The copy setup process for IRS Reporting Periods now correctly resets 1099 adjustment amounts to zero when copying from one period to another, preventing incorrect carryover of adjustment values.
key_points: Copy logic was duplicating full adjustment records instead of resetting amounts
Amount field is now explicitly set to 0 before inserting records in the target period
Automated test added to validate the copy behavior
Fixes an issue where 1099 adjustment amounts were incorrectly carried over between periods
quote: Copy Setup was incorrectly carrying 1099 adjustment amounts from source period to target period.
